chunks: And ‘Aṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib narrated from ‘Alī ibn al-Ḥusayn, upon them both be peace, who said:

When you are under oppressive leaders, then judge according to their rulings and do not expose yourselves, lest you be killed. And if you conduct your dealings according to our rulings, it will be better for you.

key_terms.بِأَحْكَامِنَا: according to our rulings, i.e. the rulings of the Imam
key_terms.تَشْهَرُوا: make yourselves known or expose yourselves publicly
key_terms.تَعَامَلْتُمْ: you conduct your dealings or transactions

ai.seo_question: What should believers do when living under unjust rulers and oppressive judges?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers living under unjust rulers to act with caution and not expose themselves to mortal danger. At the same time, it affirms that conducting affairs according to the rulings of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام is better for them.
